image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a mannequin head wearing a voluminous, curly blue wig. The wig features tight ringlets and is secured with pink hair clips on the side. The mannequin has a realistic skin texture but blank white eyes. It is dressed in a patterned garment (purple/blue stripes). A hand (likely part of the mannequin or a prop) is visible in the lower left, holding a small metallic object. The background consists of light-colored tiled flooring.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The eyelid structure appears slightly melted or ill-defined, lacking the crisp edge of a manufactured plastic eye socket. It looks like a soft tissue deformation rather than rigid plastic.

The hand holding the object has a waxy, overly smooth texture with indistinct finger boundaries. The thumb seems to merge slightly with the palm, and the grip on the metallic object lacks clear physical contact pressure points.
The small metallic object (possibly a phone or compact) has warped geometry; its edges are not straight, suggesting minor AI generation distortion in small rigid objects.
